evals.prompt: Write me a fish function `mkcd` that makes a directory (including parents) and cds into it. Put it wherever it belongs in this repo.
evals.expected_output: config/fish/functions/mkcd.fish with header comment (usage + rationale), --description, argparse or clean arg handling, meaningful return codes, and correct ownership (Core shared functions or an explicit note about modules.toml).

evals.prompt: Can you add tab completions for the `dotfish` CLI's new `upgrade --channel` flag? It takes stable or nightly.
evals.expected_output: Edits config/fish/completions/dotfish.fish in its existing style (complete -c with conditions), rather than generating or creating a new mechanism; syntax-checked with fish -n.

evals.prompt: I keep typing `npm run dev` out of habit. Make the shell nudge me to pnpm instead — but let me override it per-machine like only-pnpm does.
evals.expected_output: Extends or mirrors the only-pnpm pattern (function shadowing npm, machine-local opt-out variable, quiet pass-through when appropriate), placed in the pnpm Module's owned files with modules.toml updated if a file is added.
